# Gallery: shapes / fuse
page = canvas(name="Fused vector seam", size=(120 mm, 80 mm), background="#f7f9fc")
font = "DejaVu Sans"
heading = text(content="Fused vector seam", font_family=font, font_size=14 pt, color="#203864")
page.add(heading, target=page.top_left, offset=(7 mm, 5 mm))

box = rect(size=(23 mm, 21 mm), fill="#087f8c")

joined = page.fuse(left, stem, points=(left.middle_right, stem.start),
                   bridge_width=4 mm, junction=round, radius=2 mm,
                   fill="#087f8c", border_color="none")
# END DEMO
